user.title: Cambridge Audio Azur 851
user.description: Choose the model, then pick a detected serial port or type a connection URL. Examples: a local port `/dev/ttyUSB0`, a network bridge `socket://192.168.1.50:4001`, or an ESPHome serial proxy `esphome://192.168.1.42:6053/?port_name=851A`.

data_description.encryption_key: Only for an encrypted ESPHome serial proxy: the API encryption key (Noise PSK) from the proxy device's `api: encryption: key:`. Leave blank for local ports or socket:// bridges.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Azur 851
reconfigure.description: Update the model or serial connection for this device. Re-enter the ESPHome encryption key if the proxy uses one.

data_description.encryption_key: Only for an encrypted ESPHome serial proxy: the API encryption key (Noise PSK) from the proxy device's `api: encryption: key:`. Leave blank for local ports or socket:// bridges.
